---
title: "All pests on Chilean grape (with rachis)"
author: "Dalon White"
date: "2026-04-16"
output: html_document

params:
  begin_date: "01-01-2011" #NULL for all dates, otherwise "mm-dd-yyyy"
  end_date: "today" #NULL for today, otherwise "mm-dd-yyyy"
  # Commodity taxonomy:
  commodity_taxonomic_name: ["Vitis vinifera", "Vitis"]
  commodity_common_name: ["grape", "grapes", "grape with rachis"]
  
  # Country of origin: Looking for pests on commodities from any country of origin
  origin_country: ["Chile"]
  
  # Pest taxonomy: Looking for all pests intercepted on this commodity
  KINGDOM: NULL #["Fungi"]
  PHYLUM: NULL #["Phylum2", "Phylum3", "etc."]
  CLASS: NULL #["Insecta", "Class2", "etc."]
  ORDER: NULL #["Coleoptera", "Order2", "etc."]
  FAMILY: NULL #["Dermestidae", "Family2", "etc."]
  GENUS: NULL #["Genus2", "Genus3", "etc."]
  SPECIES: NULL #["Granarium", "Species2", "etc."]
  
  # For the title of the file on save:
  pest_nickname: NULL

---

# # If errors:

# Load libraries and parameters
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

#load packages
pacman::p_load(DBI, odbc)
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, lubridate, readr, stringr, stringdist)
pacman::p_load(DT, htmlwidgets)

```


```{r load libraries and grab params}
source(here::here("functions","filter_dates.R"))
begin_date <- get_date_params(params=params)[1]
end_date <- get_date_params(params=params)[2]

```

# Gather data from ARM
## Connect to ARM
```{r connect to ARM}  
source(here::here("functions","connect_and_access_arm.R"))
#connect to ARM
db_conn <- connect_db()
df_diag_results <- mvw_diagnostic_results()

df_diag_results <- df_diag_results |>   
  dplyr::select(
    INSPECTION_DATE,
    COMMODITY_DISPLAY_NAME,
    COMMODITY_TAXONOMIC_DISPLAY_NAME,
    INSPECTION_PATHWAY,
    ORIGIN,
    SUBCATEGORY,
    INSPECTION_LOCATION_STATE_CODE,
    DETERMINATION_TYPE,
    any_of(starts_with("PEST_TAXONOMIC_")),
    QUARANTINE_RECOMMENDATION,
    DIAGNOSTIC_DETERMINATION_ID,
    DIAGNOSTIC_REQUEST_ID,
    any_of(c(starts_with("number_dead", ignore.case = TRUE),
             starts_with("number_alive", ignore.case = TRUE),
             starts_with("pest_", ignore.case = TRUE))
    )
  )

df <- df_diag_results |> collect()
```

## Apply filters
```{r apply filters}
source(here::here("functions","filter_dates.R"))
source(here::here("functions","filter_commodity.R"))
source(here::here("functions","filter_country.R"))
source(here::here("functions","filter_taxa.R"))
results <- df |>
  filter_dates() |>
  # filter by commodity
  filter_commodity(params = params) |>
  # filter by country
  filter_country(params = params) |>
  # filter by pest taxonomy
  filter_by_taxonomy(params = params, threshold = 0.99)

results

```


## Write ARM data and Generate Report
```{r write table and report}

# Create a folder with name based on parameters
dir_name <- paste0(
  if(!is.null(params$pest_nickname)) (paste(params$pest_nickname, collapse="_")) else (paste("all pests")),
  "_on_",
  if(!(is.null(params$commodity_common_name) | is.null(params$commodity_taxonomic_name)))(paste(
    if(!is.null(params$commodity_common_name)) (paste(params$commodity_common_name, collapse="_")),
    if(!is.null(params$commodity_taxonomic_name)) (paste(params$commodity_taxonomic_name, collapse="_")))) else ("anything"),
  "_from_",
  if(!is.null(params$origin_country)) (paste(params$origin_country, collapse="_")) else ("anywhere"),
  "_from_period_",
  if(!is.null(params$begin_date)) (params$begin_date) else ("anytime"),
  "_to_",
  if(!is.null(params$end_date)) (params$end_date) else ("anytime")
)
if(!dir.exists(here::here('.gitignored','output','reports',dir_name))) dir.create(here::here('.gitignored','output','reports',dir_name), recursive = TRUE)

# Generate base filename without extension
base_filename <- paste0(
  if(!is.null(params$pest_nickname)) (paste(params$pest_nickname, collapse="_")) else (paste("all pests")),
  "_on_",
  if(!(is.null(params$commodity_common_name) | is.null(params$commodity_taxonomic_name)))(paste(
    if(!is.null(params$commodity_common_name)) (paste(params$commodity_common_name, collapse="_")),
    if(!is.null(params$commodity_taxonomic_name)) (paste(params$commodity_taxonomic_name, collapse="_")))) else ("anything"),
  "_from_",
  if(!is.null(params$origin_country)) (paste(params$origin_country, collapse="_")) else ("anywhere"),
  "_from_period_",
  if(!is.null(params$begin_date)) (params$begin_date) else ("anytime"),
  "_to_",
  if(!is.null(params$end_date)) (params$end_date) else ("anytime")
)

# Create interactive data table
dt <- datatable(results,
                extensions = 'Buttons',
                options = list(
                  dom = 'Bfrtip',
                  buttons = c('copy', 'csv', 'excel', 'pdf')
                ))

write.csv(results, file = paste0(here::here('.gitignored','output','reports',base_filename), "_data.csv"))


# Save the interactive data table
saveWidget(dt, file = paste0(here::here('.gitignored','output','reports',base_filename), "_data.html"), selfcontained = TRUE)
# Source the generate-report.R file to get the function
source(here::here("add-ons", "generate-report.R"))

# Generate and save the report
report_html <- generate_pest_report(
  data = results,
  params = params,
  base_filename = base_filename,
  include_plot = TRUE,
  include_data_preview = TRUE
)

# Save the report to file
report_file <- save_report(report_html, here::here('.gitignored','output','reports',base_filename))

# Print information about saved files
cat(paste0("\nFiles saved to folder: ", here::here('.gitignored','output','reports', dir_name, "\n")))
cat(paste0("- Interactive data table: ", here::here('.gitignored','output','reports', base_filename), "_data.html\n"))
cat(paste0("- Search report: ", report_file, "\n"))
```

# Plot diagnostic results
```{r plot results}
source(here::here('add-ons','plot-diagnostic-results.R'))

diagnostic_results_summary = summarize_diagnostic_results(results,
                                                          arrange_by = "n", #"origin" or "year"; anything else will be by total pests
                                                          truncate_origins = FALSE,
                                                          top_n_origins = 10,
                                                          group_by_origin = FALSE,
                                                          group_by_year = TRUE,
                                                          group_by_commodities = FALSE,
                                                          truncate_commodities = FALSE,
                                                          top_n_commodities = 11,
                                                          group_by_taxon = FALSE,
                                                          truncate_taxon = FALSE,
                                                          top_n_taxon = 10,
                                                          group_by_pathway = TRUE,
                                                          taxonomic_level_grouping = "genus")

save_summary(data = diagnostic_results_summary,
             base_filename = base_filename)




save_plot(data = diagnostic_results_summary,
          base_filename = paste0(base_filename,'_plot'),
          plot_x = "COMMODITY_DISPLAY_NAME",
          xlab = "Commodity",
          plot_y = "total_pests",
          ylab = "Total Pests",
          plot_fill = "INSPECTION_PATHWAY",
          fill_lab = "Pathway",
          plot_title = "Pest Interceptions by commodity and pathway",
          plot_subtitle = "Summary of pest interceptions",
          width = 10,
          height = 7,
          dpi = 300)


```
